headline: AI goes on the hack: Australia and South Korea face a new type of cyberattack
summary: After a series of hacker attacks on South Korean financial organisations, an emergency review was launched at about 500 financial companies, and President Lee Jae-myung intervened.
why: Cyberattacks on banks and financial firms raise operational, data and regulatory risks for the financial sector.
